decisions.rationale: 'Inherited C3 deficiency' refers to one specific disease, C3 deficiency, which has a single definition without further categorization. The optional qualifier 'Inherited' is kept because the candidate span is given as is.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); Examples 6 and 16

decisions.rationale: 'recurrent infections' is a very general term that does not name a specific disease or disease family, similar to excluded general terms such as 'complications' or 'infectious complications'.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4 (General terms); Examples 6

decisions.rationale: 'glomerulonephritis' is an unspecified umbrella term for a family of multiple distinct kidney diseases, so it is a Disease Class rather than one specific disease.

'homozygous deficiency of the third component of complement' is the long-form description of the single specific disease C3 deficiency in this patient, so it is annotated as one Specific Disease using the full phrase as the preferred span.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease) and 5 (Minimum necessary span)

decisions.rationale: 'recurrent bacterial infections' is a generic description of infections without naming a specific disease or a clearly defined disease family, so it is too general to annotate.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4 (General terms); Examples 6

decisions.rationale: 'pneumonia' names a single clinical disease concept (inflammation of the lungs) that is linked to one definition without further subcategorization in this text.
'mesangiopathic glomerulonephritis' names a particular form of glomerulonephritis with one specific definition, so it is a Specific Disease and the full phrase is kept as the minimal span.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease) and 5 (Minimum necessary span)

decisions.rationale: 'C3 deficiency' refers to one specific disease, complement component 3 deficiency, with a single definition.
'immune-complex disease' refers to a family of diseases caused by immune complex deposition, so it is a Disease Class rather than one specific disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Disease Class definition); Examples 10

decisions.rationale: 'severe pyogenic infections' is a broad, general description of infections and does not name a specific disease or defined disease family, so it is excluded as too general.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4 (General terms); Examples 6

decisions.rationale: 'C3 deficiency' in the final sentence refers to the same single specific disease, complement component 3 deficiency, as the earlier mention.
